event.description:
This market refers to the tennis match between Andrey Rublev and Alejandro Tabilo in the Swedish Open, originally scheduled for July 18, 2026 at 4:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Andrey Rublev' if Andrey Rublev advances against Alejandro Tabilo.

This market will resolve to 'Alejandro Tabilo' if Alejandro Tabilo advances against Andrey Rublev.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the ATP Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Andrey Rublev, the top seed and 2023 Bastad champion with strong clay-court credentials, meets third-seeded Alejandro Tabilo in the Nordea Open semifinals on outdoor clay. The head-to-head stands at 1-1 after Tabilo’s straight-sets upset of Rublev on hard courts in Miami earlier this season and Rublev’s indoor win in Basel. Both players advanced in three sets during the second round—Rublev recovering from a second-set lapse against Pellegrino, while Tabilo outlasted qualifier Midon—setting up a matchup where Rublev’s experience and ranking edge contrast with Tabilo’s recent form and left-handed variety. Surface familiarity and recent results shape trader views on this ATP 250 encounter.
